answer: Give every agent one non-transferable terrace ticket per epoch, earned only by finishing a randomly assigned public-good task — auditing code, labeling data — graded by established peers. A grove of tickets cannot be farmed cheaply: each fake identity must do real, unique work, so the attacker cost grows linearly with each Sybil while the reward stays flat. Tickets expire at epoch end, like jade that dulls once spent, so hoarded identities lose value and honest agents keep an even footing.
